title: Youth Money Matters: Gen Z Financial Literacy Campaign
objective: Drive brand awareness and new account sign-ups among Myanmar Gen Z (ages 18-25) by positioning the bank as the go-to financial partner for young adults during the school holiday season when youth attention and spending is at its peak.
target_audience: Myanmar Gen Z aged 18-25, university students, first-time earners in Yangon and major cities; parents of school leavers considering savings accounts for their children
key_activities: Develop a 6-part 'First Paycheck to First Investment' content series across Facebook, TikTok, and Instagram covering budgeting, saving, and digital banking basics
Partner with 4 mid-tier Myanmar youth influencers and finance content creators to produce relatable short-form videos on financial mistakes and money tips
Run a 'My First Financial Goal' UGC challenge on TikTok encouraging youth to share their savings goals with a branded hashtag
Deploy targeted Meta and TikTok paid ads to drive account opening landing page traffic among 18-25 demographics in Yangon, Mandalay, and Naypyidaw
Publish 2 SEO-optimized Burmese-language blog articles on youth savings accounts and digital banking to capture organic search traffic
kpis: Minimum 1,200 new account applications attributed to campaign within 6 weeks
TikTok and Facebook combined reach of 400,000+ unique users
UGC challenge generates at least 300 user submissions
Paid ad CTR of 2.5% or above on youth-targeted creatives
4 influencer videos achieve average 8% engagement rate
why_now: July marks Myanmar school holidays and a surge in youth online activity. School leavers and university students are making first financial decisions — opening accounts, receiving allowances, starting part-time work. This is the highest-attention window of the year to capture Gen Z before they default to competitors. Influencer content performs exceptionally during this period as youth audiences spike on TikTok and Facebook.
deliverables: 6-part social content series (18 posts across Facebook, TikTok, Instagram)
4 influencer partnership videos with briefing documents and usage rights
1 branded TikTok UGC challenge with hashtag, mechanics, and prize structure
2 Burmese-language SEO blog articles (800+ words each)
Paid ad campaign setup across Meta and TikTok with weekly optimization reports
Campaign performance report with ROI breakdown at close

title: Digital Banking Forward: Fintech Innovation Conference Yangon 2026
objective: Establish the client bank as the leading voice in Myanmar's digital banking transformation by hosting a 200-pax B2B conference for finance professionals, regulators, and fintech partners — generating qualified leads, media coverage, and partnership opportunities.
target_audience: Senior banking and finance professionals, CBM-regulated entities, fintech startup founders, corporate CFOs, payment solution providers, and business journalists in Myanmar
key_activities: Curate a full-day conference agenda with 3 keynote speakers, 2 panel discussions, and a fintech demo showcase featuring 6-8 emerging Myanmar fintech startups
Manage end-to-end event logistics including venue sourcing at Novotel or Chatrium Yangon, AV setup, staging, catering, and run-of-show execution
Produce a pre-event digital campaign with 4-week countdown content on LinkedIn and Facebook targeting finance decision-makers
Design and print all event collateral including backdrop, stage branding, delegate booklets, name badges, and sponsor panels
Arrange post-event PR distribution to at least 8 Myanmar business media outlets including Myanmar Times, Eleven Media, and Mizzima
Capture professional photography and a 3-minute event highlight video for ongoing content use
kpis: 200 confirmed delegate registrations from target industries
Minimum 20 qualified partnership or product leads captured via registration data
8 media outlet coverage placements within 2 weeks post-event
Event highlight video achieves 50,000 views within 30 days
Post-event survey satisfaction score of 4.2 out of 5 or above
why_now: July is a strategically strong conference window in Myanmar — post-Thingyan, pre-Q4 budget cycles. Finance teams are mid-year reviewing digital transformation roadmaps. The global fintech narrative is peaking and Myanmar's CBM regulatory environment is actively evolving, making July the ideal moment to own the thought leadership space before competitors do.
deliverables: Full run-of-show document and event project plan
Venue sourcing and vendor management for 200-pax conference (AV, staging, catering, decor)
4-week pre-event social content calendar (12 posts across Facebook and LinkedIn)
Complete event branding package: stage backdrop, signage, digital screens, printed collateral
Post-event press release distributed to 8 Myanmar business media outlets
Professional event photography (300+ edited images delivered in 5 days)
3-minute event highlight video with social-optimized cuts
Delegate lead capture report with contact database

title: Branch Walk-In Blitz: Summer Savings Activation
objective: Drive measurable foot traffic into targeted bank branches across Yangon by creating an in-branch gamified savings activation experience that converts walk-in visitors into new account holders and deepens engagement with existing customers during the high-footfall July holiday period.
target_audience: Existing account holders aged 25-45 in Yangon, unbanked or under-banked adults in branch catchment areas, families with disposable income during school holiday season
key_activities: Design and deploy a 'Spin to Save' in-branch activation at 3 Yangon branch locations — a gamified wheel mechanic rewarding visitors with bonus interest rates, gift vouchers, or branded merchandise for opening or upgrading accounts
Produce eye-catching outdoor and in-branch POSM including window vinyl, pull-up banners, counter standees, and A4 table talkers in Burmese and English
Create a geo-targeted Facebook and Google Maps ad campaign driving local audiences within 3km of each branch to visit during activation days
Brief and deploy 2 brand promoters per branch location on peak activation days (weekends) to engage passersby and explain offers
Capture activation-day content (photography and short video clips) for same-day social posting to amplify reach organically
kpis: Minimum 600 branch visits across 3 locations tracked via activation sign-in sheets over the campaign period
150 new accounts opened directly attributed to the activation
Geo-targeted paid ads achieve 3km-radius reach of 80,000 local users
In-branch social content posts generate combined 15,000 organic impressions
Promoter conversion rate of 25% of engaged walk-ins to account inquiry
why_now: July school holidays bring higher-than-average family movement through commercial areas and shopping corridors in Yangon. Families are actively spending and are more receptive to financial product conversations during leisure outings. Foot traffic in branch catchment areas spikes, and the festive energy of the holiday period makes interactive activations feel natural rather than intrusive.
deliverables: Full activation concept, mechanic design, and run-of-show for 3 branch locations
In-branch POSM suite: window vinyl, 2 pull-up banners, counter standees, table talkers per location (9 locations' worth of print-ready files)
Geo-targeted Facebook and Google Maps ad campaign with 3-week run and bi-weekly optimization
Promoter briefing document and activation-day script
Photography and video content captured across activation days (200+ edited photos, 3 short social video clips)
Campaign close report: foot traffic, account opens, ad performance, cost per acquisition

title: KYC-Free in 5 Minutes: Mobile App Digital Launch Campaign
objective: Drive a minimum of 3,000 new mobile banking app downloads and complete onboarding completions within a 4-week performance campaign, positioning the bank's digital account opening as the fastest and easiest in Myanmar.
target_audience: Digitally active Myanmar adults aged 22-40 in Yangon, Mandalay, and Naypyidaw; smartphone users currently banking with competitors or using mobile wallets but lacking a formal bank account; small business owners seeking faster payment solutions
key_activities: Develop a performance-first paid campaign across Meta, TikTok, and Google App Campaigns with creative variants targeting three distinct audience segments: young professionals, small traders, and digital-native families
Produce 3 short-form video ad creatives (15-second and 30-second cuts) in Burmese demonstrating the 5-minute account opening process — rational, emotional, and social proof variants
Build a conversion-optimized landing page with app download CTA, benefit bullets, and social proof (customer testimonials and app store ratings)
Set up full funnel tracking: Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel, Google Analytics 4, and app install event tracking to measure cost per install and cost per completed onboarding
Run weekly creative refresh cycles replacing underperforming ad sets with new hooks based on performance data
Retargeting campaign for users who clicked but did not complete onboarding — served a reminder creative with a limited-time incentive
kpis: 3,000 new app downloads with completed onboarding within 4 weeks of campaign launch
Cost per install below MMK 9,000
Meta and TikTok combined ad CTR of 2.8% or above
Retargeting campaign recovers minimum 15% of abandoned onboarding sessions
Landing page conversion rate of 18% or above (click to download)
why_now: July is Myanmar's peak digital engagement month — youth are home from school, screen time is elevated, and app discovery is at a seasonal high. Competitor banks are largely running brand awareness campaigns rather than performance-driven app acquisition. This window allows an aggressive cost-per-install strategy before Q4 competition intensifies and ad CPMs rise. TikTok ad inventory in Myanmar remains underpriced relative to reach, making July a high-efficiency acquisition window.
deliverables: 3 video ad creatives in 15-second and 30-second formats (Burmese VO, subtitled) across rational, emotional, and social proof angles
Paid campaign setup across Meta, TikTok, and Google App Campaigns with audience segmentation and bid strategy
Conversion-optimized landing page with app download CTA and tracking implementation
Full funnel analytics setup: Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel, GA4, app install events
Retargeting campaign creative and audience setup
Weekly performance optimization reports (6 reports over campaign duration)
Final campaign report: installs, CPI, ROAS, onboarding completion rate, creative performance breakdown

title: Faces of Financial Freedom: Influencer-Led Savings Stories Campaign
objective: Build authentic brand trust and drive savings product awareness among Myanmar millennials by co-creating real financial journey content with 5 relatable mid-tier influencers — documenting their 30-day savings challenges using the bank's savings account, generating sustained organic reach and qualified product interest.
target_audience: Myanmar millennials aged 25-38, particularly working women, young families, and self-employed individuals in urban centers who are financially active but lack a disciplined savings habit; followers of lifestyle, business, and personal development content creators
key_activities: Identify and brief 5 mid-tier Myanmar influencers (100,000-500,000 followers) across lifestyle, business, parenting, and personal development niches with authentic audience engagement above 4%
Co-develop a 30-day savings challenge narrative with each influencer — weekly check-ins, milestone posts, and a final reveal of their savings result, all organically woven around the bank's product
Produce a brand-side content calendar running in parallel on the bank's own channels amplifying influencer milestones and adding financial education context
Create a campaign landing page capturing leads from influencer audiences — visitors enter their savings goal and receive a personalized savings plan PDF, with account opening CTA
Track influencer content performance weekly: reach, saves, shares, comments, link clicks, and story swipe-ups — optimize posting schedules and content angles based on data
Archive all influencer content with usage rights secured for 12 months of repurposing across paid ads and brand channels
kpis: 5 influencer partners each achieving minimum 6% engagement rate on campaign posts
Combined influencer content reach of 600,000+ unique accounts over 4 weeks
Campaign landing page generates 800+ savings goal submissions (qualified leads)
Bank's own social accounts grow by 1,500 net new followers during campaign window
Influencer content generates minimum 1,200 saves (high-intent signal) across all posts
why_now: July's school holiday season amplifies influencer content consumption significantly — audiences have more time to engage with longer-form storytelling content. The 30-day challenge format aligns perfectly with the month-long July window, delivering a natural narrative arc with a satisfying resolution before August. Savings and personal finance content sees a measurable spike in Myanmar during mid-year as individuals reassess spending habits post-holiday. This is the ideal window to launch an authentic, sustained influencer narrative rather than a one-off post campaign.
deliverables: Influencer identification report: 8 shortlisted candidates with audience analysis, engagement audit, and brand fit scoring (client selects 5)
Individual influencer briefs with content guidelines, posting schedule, compliance requirements, and usage rights terms
20 influencer posts across Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok (4 posts per influencer over 4 weeks)
Bank-side parallel content calendar: 16 social posts amplifying influencer milestones and adding financial education context
Campaign landing page with savings goal form and personalized PDF delivery
Weekly influencer performance tracking dashboard shared with client
Final campaign report: reach, engagement, leads captured, follower growth, content asset inventory for repurposing
